summary: API contract for review rounds is mostly sound on the production path (required publish field, marker serialization, fail-closed reuse/stats, additive review-stats rounds), but the monorepo contract migration is incomplete: the shared qube-testkit publish conformance suite still omits the newly required ReviewLaneReviewPublishInput.round, and adapter publish paths do not runtime-validate a non-empty round before minting markers.
blockers: Required ReviewLaneReviewPublishInput.round is not supplied by the packages/qube-testkit publishLaneReviewFeedback conformance call, so the monorepo public publish contract is incomplete at this head.

findings.message: ReviewLaneReviewPublishInput.round is required on the shared qube-core/aie publish contract, but packages/qube-testkit/src/review-suite.ts still calls publishLaneReviewFeedback without round (only expectedLanes). Under strict TypeScript this breaks the conformance suite against the updated core type; the shared adapter suite no longer exercises the complete publish shape this PR introduced.
findings.suggestion: Add a deterministic non-empty round to the conformance payload (for example a fixed test round id or the same reviewRoundId inputs used by aie), and assert the dry-run body/marker includes round.

findings.message: GitHub and GitLab publish adapters serialize input.round into markers and skip-match on it, but neither path validates that round is a non-empty string at runtime. JavaScript callers (including several adapters/gitlab/test/gitlab.test.mjs publish fixtures that omit round) can still mint markers without round, producing provider records whose round membership is undecidable unless expectedLanes+issueNumber allow derivation.
findings.suggestion: Reject publish when typeof input.round !== 'string' or input.round.trim() === '' before building marker metadata, matching the TypeScript required field.

findings.message: Mode/provider matrix coverage for the new required field is uneven: GitLab unit fixtures commonly publish without round (baseInput around the withheld/head-advance cases), while production aie always supplies reviewRoundId. That leaves GitLab marker+skip-match behavior for missing/empty round under-specified relative to GitHub and the core type.
findings.suggestion: Add round to GitLab publish fixtures and assert forged metadata/skip-match include round for both providers.
